set.body:
fmri_lm(formula, block, dataset, baseline_model = NULL, durations = 0,
          control = fmri_lm_control(), compute = compute_spec(),
          engine = NULL, ...)

9 formals. All 29 existing ones keep working, implemented as translation onto
specs, so nothing breaks in this bead.

Promote cfg to a documented formal named control; keep cfg as a deprecated alias.

Conflict policy - errors, never silent precedence:

  Error: `ar_options` and `control` both supplied.
    `ar_options` is deprecated; move it into `control`:
      control = fmri_lm_control(noise = noise_spec(struct = "ar2"))

A deprecated argument alone warns once per session and is translated. Alongside
control it is an error. None of the current precedence rules are worth preserving.
set.title: fmri_lm(): add control= and compute= formals; conflict policy
